messages:
sam: quick idea — decouple the ingest verifier into a separate service. run it async and cache results. get faster pushes and make onboarding non-blocking. thoughts?

ana: yes. biggest win is avoiding a long blocking path when a model upload triggers full benches. we can return a fast-accept + background-verify.

ravi: tradeoff is duplicate work if we still run lightweight checks at ingest and then full verify later. also where do we keep canonical artifacts?

marta: agree. question: API boundary — verifier should accept an immutable artifact reference (s3:// or digest) + policy id. it returns pass/fail + evidence blob link. minimal.

sam: sketch of the API I had in mind:
```yaml
POST /v1/verify
body:
  model_digest: sha256:...
  artifact_uri: s3://redwood-models/....tar.gz
  checks:
    - smoke_latency_profile
    - tokenizer_roundtrip
    - kv_cache_compat
  policy: onboarding-default
response: 
  verification_id: uuid
  status: queued
```

ravi: sounds good. where to put results? we should attach to model registry metadata + expose a small TTL cache for recent digests. avoid re-running expensive benches for the same digest.

marta: +1. also we need deterministic evidence format so Dedicated/Private teams can replay. propose evidence is gzipped JSON with per-check logs and seed.

verifier-bot: automated: note — existing bench infra can run as workers for verifier, but memory/kind constraints may need a stripped runner for quick checks.

ana: perf question — how will we measure verification cost impact? proposal: track per-verification token-count, wall-time, and a synthetic QPS baseline. add a cost budget flag on policy so long checks fail fast.

sam: operational considerations:
- fallback: if verifier is down, ingest returns 'queued-offline' and a manual gating page for SRE
- canary: start with token-limited dedicated pool for 2 weeks
- metrics: verification_latency, verification_queue_depth, repeated_digest_hits

ravi: implementation plan: 1) prototype verifier microservice that reads artifacts, runs tokenizer + small smoke bench, stores evidence; 2) add registry link + cache layer; 3) add policy config UI hooks. estimate: 2 weeks for prototype, 1 more week for perf tuning.

marta: blockers: auth for artifact reads (Signed URLs vs role), and a canonical artifact immutability guarantee. I'll draft the ingestion-only invariant.

sam: ok let's spin up a shared doc + PR. ravi volunteers to lead prototype, marta will own artifact auth. ana will own policy defs. i'll open a follow-up thread with the doc link. :thumbsup:

verifier-bot: task created — ticket #ENG-ML-1248 assigned to ravi, due 2024-06-07
